# NoPayNoDate

> NoPayNoDate is a technical demo, not a real dating service. It shows a deposit-backed dating flow built with Next.js and Stripe. The profiles are fictional, payments run in Stripe test mode, and no real money moves.

## What this site is

A portfolio project by TeeBo Studio (https://teebostudio.fr). Visitors enter the demo in one click and receive two throwaway accounts, one on each side of the flow. The accounts are deleted within 48 hours. Nobody can sign up.

## The flow being demonstrated

1. A woman sets a deposit amount between $20 and $200.
2. A man pays that deposit to send her a date request (Stripe test card).
3. The deposit is held until she decides, and a private chat opens.
4. If she declines, the man is refunded in full.
5. If she accepts and both confirm the date took place, the deposit is released to her, minus a 10% commission. In the demo this payout is simulated.

## What is built

- Authentication, profiles, browsing with filters
- Stripe payments with held deposits, refunds and a simulated payout
- Real-time chat
- A demo mode with one sandbox per visitor, rate limits and automatic cleanup

## Tech stack

Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, tRPC, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL (Neon), Better Auth, Stripe, Pusher, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.
